rule: Put next/font variable classes on <html> when a plain Tailwind v4 @theme reads them (or use @theme inline).
why: @theme resolves var() at :root; a variable set on <body> is undefined there and the font silently falls back to the system stack.

evidence.note: incumbent: Geist loaded, 100% of text rendered in ui-sans-serif
redesign: Geologica/JetBrains never applied until moved to <html>

check.message: next/font variable set on <body> but read by a plain @theme at :root

rule: Never animate pathLength on a path that must stay dashed; reveal the dashed path through an animated mask instead.
why: Framer Motion's pathLength writes its own stroke-dasharray and overrides yours, so a dashed plan renders solid.

evidence.note: redesign: hero planned course rendered solid

check.message: motion.path with both strokeDasharray and a pathLength animation

rule: Keep the same initial/animate props on server and client; under reduced motion collapse the transition to zero instead of branching the props.
why: useReducedMotion is null on the server; branching initial={false} on the client causes a hydration mismatch that can leave paths undrawn.

evidence.note: redesign: hero course missing under reduced motion; hydration warning

check.message: initial/animate props branch on useReducedMotion during render

rule: In Tailwind v3, define theme colours as hex (or rgb channels), not var(--x), if opacity modifiers like bg-x/50 are used.
why: Tailwind v3 cannot apply an alpha modifier to an opaque CSS variable, so bg-x/50 generates nothing.

evidence.note: mobile overlay and header backgrounds did not render

check.message: Tailwind v3 theme colours defined as var(--…) while opacity modifiers are used

rule: Under Tailwind v4, keep tokens in @theme; a tailwind.config file does nothing without an @config line.
why: An inherited landing page's whole theme (primary, accent, surface, Inter) was dead, and the utilities that named it generated no CSS.

rule: No small label, eyebrow or kicker above a heading; let the heading carry it, or make the label the heading.
why: Reviewers flagged it on three different sites; it is the most reliable sign of a templated page.

evidence.note: redesign: mode label above mode heading; small green label above answers

rule: Lay content out in the committed world's structure; an equal grid of icon + heading + text in a box is still a card grid.
why: Both redesigns first shipped a 2x2 or 3-column card grid inside a strong world and were sent back for it.

evidence.note: How I work three-column triplet; project cards

rule: An action without a destination must look inert and say why; never give it the primary style.
why: Green 'link coming' store buttons still read as live; neutral outline plus a plain line fixed it.

evidence.note: redesign: store buttons before links exist

rule: Devices borrowed from a real system must obey it: coordinates stop at 59 minutes, charts read like charts, numbers are plausible.
why: A decorative coordinate scale counted to 06°112′N and the reviewer called it a false statement.

rule: Remove rankings, counts and endorsements the evidence cannot back; record their absence in PRODUCT.md.
why: An inherited page claimed '#1 Productivity Software' with no source; PRODUCT.md now forbids repeating it.

rule: Keep decorative text (soundings, scale labels, watermarks) out of the area content occupies, at every breakpoint.
why: Soundings under the headline and scale labels under a panel were flagged as text occlusion.

rule: On phones, give hero art its own space in the flow; don't overlay it on copy that is anchored to the bottom.
why: When the font loaded, the copy grew and the headline climbed over the absolutely positioned chart band.

rule: Review the reduced-motion still record as a page in its own right, not only the motion version.
why: A product page's pinned chapters overlapped under reduced motion; every review had looked only at motion-on captures.

evidence.note: found by loom capture, still unfixed

rule: Take review screenshots with loom capture, never a tall-window screenshot or a cropped wide window.
why: Tall windows stretch 100vh heroes, desktop Chrome cannot go below ~500px, and reveals get caught mid-fade.

rule: When running a Claude Code hook script by hand, pipe its JSON input on stdin.
why: A SessionStart security hook run bare waited on stdin and hung for minutes in the background.

rule: Ask before installing; reinstall with npm ci --ignore-scripts from the lockfile and scan node_modules for worm markers before running anything.
why: npm installs execute third-party code; a supply-chain worm spread this way in Sep 2026.

rule: Never put the worm's literal loader strings in source, even in tests; assemble them at runtime.
why: A test fixture string would have made a session security hook flag loom itself as infected.
